NEE_site_daily %>% # NEE data include spad and NDVI
  filter(site != "CS04") %>% 
  filter(site != "EF03") %>% 
  replace_with_na_at(.vars = "NDVI_mean",
                     condition = ~.x > 1) %>% # remove spurious NDVI values
  gather(-site, 
         -month, 
         -date, 
         -year, 
         key = "environ_var", value = "value",
         ) %>% 
  # deselect variables we don't need:
  select(-c(n_collars,
            CO2_NEE_daily_mean,CO2_NEE_daily_se,
            CH4_NEE_daily_mean, CH4_NEE_daily_se)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(month), y = value, fill = site))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(color = "red", alpha = 0.2, size = 0.1)+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "management:", 
                      labels = c("regenerative corn", 
                                 "conventional corn", "organic dairy pasture"))+
  labs(x = "month",
       y = element_blank())+
  facet_grid(environ_var~ year, 
             scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(environ_var = var_labels))+ # Add labeller here
  theme_bw()
